definition: NHANES household interview / prescription medication inventory date
Any reported use of a prescription drug class in the past 30 days at time zero
Current drug class use with RXDDAYS >= 365 or >= 730 days
Lifetime self-reported kidney stone history as of time zero (KIQ026)
No prospective follow-up is observed in NHANES; estimates are interpreted as adjusted prevalence effects/associations under a target-trial-style framework
